source: Actual B68 PixelLab selected-view edits and independent gpt-5.6-luna re-reviews; local execution, no production publication

initialReport.repairDescription: Preserve the compact outlined pixel style and the tan-and-white identity. Repair the WEST view's rear tail, which is visibly cramped against the right canvas edge and reads as clipped or incomplete; keep its carriage consistent with the complete short tail shown in EAST.
initialReport.note: 네 방향 모두 스타일과 주요 정체성 무늬는 일치합니다. WEST만 꼬리 가장자리 처리가 필요합니다.

views.note: 정면 방향과 얼굴·코트 무늬가 사진과 잘 맞고, 눈과 중립적인 입도 읽힙니다.
후면에 얼굴이 없는 것은 올바르며, 사진에서 가려진 후면 무늬와 꼬리는 판단하지 않았습니다.
방향과 코트 무늬는 맞지만, 오른쪽 꼬리가 캔버스 가장자리에 붙어 끝이 잘린 듯하며 완전한 꼬리로 읽히지 않습니다.
옆면 방향과 주요 흰색 무늬가 맞고, 꼬리 끝도 캔버스 안에서 자연스럽게 보입니다.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: Tan head and upright tan ears, a broad white forehead blaze continuing down the white muzzle, white chest and white front legs, with tan cheek patches. The dark mouth is a small neutral contour beneath the muzzle, not a grin.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The visible front photo shows tan upright ears and head, a broad white blaze from forehead to muzzle, white muzzle and throat/chest, and white legs. The body rear and tail are not clearly visible in this front view.
views.note: 정면 방향과 얼굴·코트 무늬가 사진과 잘 맞고, 눈과 중립적인 입도 읽힙니다.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: Rear-facing tan head and body with darker tan ear/back areas, a small white patch at the upper neck, and a broad white lower rear/leg area. No eyes or face are shown; no tail is visibly separated from the rear silhouette.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The photographs show tan-and-white coloring, but the rear and tail are hidden or not visible, so rear markings and tail shape are unknown.
views.note: 후면에 얼굴이 없는 것은 올바르며, 사진에서 가려진 후면 무늬와 꼬리는 판단하지 않았습니다.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: Left-facing short-coated profile with tan upright ears and tan head, a white forehead/muzzle area, white throat and chest band, white lower legs, and a tan body. A very small dark-edged tail nub is pressed against the right canvas edge.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The visible side photo shows tan head and ears, a white blaze and muzzle, white throat/chest, and white legs. The tail and most rear-body details are hidden in the available photographs.
views.note: 방향과 코트 무늬는 맞지만, 오른쪽 꼬리가 캔버스 가장자리에 붙어 끝이 잘린 듯하며 완전한 꼬리로 읽히지 않습니다.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: Right-facing short-coated profile with tan upright ears and head, a visible white forehead/muzzle region, white throat and chest, white lower legs, and a tan body. The short tan tail extends left from the rump with a visible outlined end.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The visible side photo shows tan head and ears, a white blaze and muzzle, white throat/chest, and white legs. The tail is hidden in the photographs, so its exact shape is unknown.
views.note: 옆면 방향과 주요 흰색 무늬가 맞고, 꼬리 끝도 캔버스 안에서 자연스럽게 보입니다.

finalReport.note: 네 방향 모두 의도한 방향과 실제 사진의 주요 무늬, 승인된 픽셀 스타일에 부합합니다.

views.note: 정면 방향과 얼굴 무늬, 눈 표현이 사진과 일치합니다.
후면답게 얼굴이 없으며, 사진에 숨겨진 후면 무늬와 충돌하지 않습니다.
좌측 프로필의 방향, 짧은 털, 주요 흰색·갈색 배치가 자연스럽습니다.
우측 프로필의 방향과 얼굴·가슴 무늬가 실제 사진과 일치합니다.

views.observedPhotoMarkings: The front photographs show a broad white blaze, white muzzle, white throat/chest and white legs, with tan-brown ears and cheek/forehead areas. The rear and full tail are not clearly visible in this view.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: The left-facing profile has a white muzzle and forehead blaze, a white throat/chest and lower belly, white feet, and a tan-brown back and flank patch. It has one readable dark eye and a small curled upright tail.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The visible side/front photographs show a white muzzle and blaze, white throat/chest and legs, and tan-brown head and body patches. The complete tail is hidden or not clearly shown in the photographs.

views.observedSpriteMarkings: The right-facing profile has a white muzzle and forehead blaze, white throat/chest and lower legs, tan-brown head and back, and a small curled upright tail. One dark eye is clearly readable.
views.observedPhotoMarkings: The visible profile photograph shows the white muzzle and blaze, white throat/chest, and tan-brown head and neck; the full tail and far-side body markings are hidden or not clearly visible.
